regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing, non-directional rotation where the nominal leader (Oil & Gas Producers) is NOT eligible — it fails the absolute-trend gate (durability_bar 0.19, mixed Hurst, breadth 0.071). The eligible leadership is Big Banks (rank 2, trend, full breadth, not crowded), followed by the crowded Consumer Staples & Retail and trend-healthy Utilities. Backtest verdict confirms the only validated edge is drawdown/shake-out control via the trend gate; momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha. Track record hit rate 55.8% but directional accuracy 31.3% over 147 calls — near coin-flip, so conviction must default low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Big Banks actually asserts leadership over the ineligible Oil & Gas leader. The observable condition: ZEB.TO sustains a positive relative return versus XEG.TO and the S&P/TSX for 10 consecutive trading days. If that coherence forms, the Banks-take-the-mantle hypothesis strengthens; if ZEB.TO breaks down below its 20-day relative trend against XEG.TO, the watch retires.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is the highest-ranked ELIGIBLE theme (rank 2, score 0.99). It clears the absolute-trend gate (eligibile=true) with strong durability (0.8), a clean 'trend' Hurst tag and full breadth (1.0). It is not crowded (z=0.61). Momentum rank is not a return forecast, but the trend-gate is the one validated risk-control leg and Big Banks passes it while the nominal leader (Oil & Gas) does not. This is a volatility-aware stay-with-trend lean, not a prediction of outperformance.
evidence: eligible=true and durability_bar=0.8 pass the validated absolute-trend gate
hurst_tag='trend' and breadth=1.0 indicate broad, cohesive participation
rank=2 and score=0.99 are the highest among eligible themes
theses.dissent: Headline weight (0.25) and high durability may mean much of the move is already priced; consensus leadership can stall when the macro backdrop shifts, and CA banks are rate-sensitive to the BOC.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO lags the S&P/TSX by 3% or more between now and the check-by date

theses.subject: Consumer Staples & Retail
theses.thesis: Consumer Staples & Retail is eligible (rank 3) with trend durability, but it is the only crowded eligible theme (crowding_z=1.03, crowded=true). Crowding is a size-down caution only — not a fade. However, the guardrails explicitly warn not to chase extended/crowded leadership, and with directional accuracy at 0.313, a crowded third-ranked theme offers no asymmetric edge. Avoid is a de-risking stance, not a short.
evidence: crowded=true (crowding_z=1.03) triggers the sizing caution leg
guardrails.do_not_conclude: crowd acts as a down-size, never a buy trigger
eligible=true but only rank 3 behind Big Banks in eligible stack
theses.dissent: Defensive staples could benefit from continued macro uncertainty (unscheduled_share=1.0 in the macro backdrop), and breadth is full (1.0) — the crowding flag alone has no forward edge.

falsifier.text: XST.TO outperforms ZEB.TO by more than 3% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Uranium & Nuclear
theses.thesis: Uranium & Nuclear is the weakest theme in the entire stack (rank 16, score -2.513), is ineligible for the trend gate (eligible=false, durability_bar 0.23), has zero breadth (0.0), and is negatively crowded (crowding_z=-1.05). This is a rotational-laggard lean, not a momentum call — the absolute-trend gate specifically exists to avoid shake-outs like this. Note it is unscorable (no ETF proxy), so this is a low-conviction directional lean only.
evidence: rank=16 and score=-2.513 — deepest negative in the ranks
eligible=false, durability_bar=0.23, hurst_tag='trend' but breadth=0.0 — no participation
crowding_z=-1.05 signals capital is fleeing, not accumulating
